title: Father the Methodist preacher, mother singing hymns
summary: His father was a preacher and songster who died when he was young; his mother sang hymns at church and did not play in church.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Did your father or mother, anybody play? Anybody in your family play instruments?
Well, my father was a pianist and a songster. Played piano?
Yeah. Did your father play anything?
No. Nothing? No, my father, he was a preacher.
Oh. What denomination, Baptist or Methodist?
And your mother, did she sing hymns? Yeah. And anything else?
Nothing but hymns. Do you remember any of the ones she sang? No, I don't remember.
But I know she sang quite a bit of hymns. She sang in the union's Bethel's church, quiet.
Did she play piano in the church too?
No, no, she didn't play in the church. She was just at home. Mm-hmm.
